steps.name: Check the checkout left no credentials behind
steps.run:
if git config --local --get-regexp 'http\..*\.extraheader' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "the checkout persisted a credential in .git/config" >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Build the SDK and run the system tests against it
Check the integration tests ran, against 1.0
steps.run:
summary=system-tests/target/failsafe-reports/failsafe-summary.xml
if [ ! -f "$summary" ]; then
  echo "no failsafe summary: the integration tests did not run" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if grep -q '<completed>0</completed>' "$summary"; then
  echo "failsafe ran zero integration tests" >&2
  exit 1
fi
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
report = "system-tests/target/failsafe-reports/TEST-com.oddin.oddsfeed.systemtests.BuildWiringIT.xml"
cases = {c.get("name"): c for c in ET.parse(report).getroot().iter("testcase")}
case = cases.get("theSdkIsTheOneThisReactorBuilt")
if case is None:
    sys.exit("BuildWiringIT did not check the 1.0 SDK's version: no such test in the report")
outcome = [child.tag for child in case if child.tag in ("skipped", "failure", "error")]
if outcome:
    sys.exit("BuildWiringIT did not check the 1.0 SDK's version: " + outcome[0])
PY
skipped=$(sed -n 's:.*<skipped>\([0-9]*\)</skipped>.*:\1:p' "$summary")
echo "integration tests skipped, most of them pending on 1.0: ${skipped:-0}"
